title: DC-area forecast: More clouds, breezes, and some showers today before nor’easter moves away
subtitle: HAPPENING NOW: We catch the gusty breeze and clouds from a nor'easter for one more day. Occasional showers could disrupt outdoor plans at times with cool highs around 60 to 65.
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: We catch the gusty breeze and clouds from a nor'easter for one more day. Occasional showers disrupt outdoor plans at times with cool highs around 60 to 65.

What’s next? Mostly cloudy Monday but dry, less windy, and a touch warmer as the storm moves away. Plenty of sun and building warmth midweek.

Today’s daily digit — 4/10: A September nor'easter continues to sweep in cloudy skies, gusty winds, and cool vibes – oh, and some showers too. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

Forecast in detail

Today (Sunday): Cloudy with occasional light to moderate showers. It's also rather windy, with gusts from the northwest of 25 to 35 mph, and highs only around 60 to 65. Rainfall in most spots should be around a quarter inch or less, heaviest across the eastern half of the area. Confidence: Medium

Radar forecast for today

Tonight: Still breezy into the evening with a spotty shower possible. Remaining overcast overnight with lighter winds and lows in the upper 50s to near 60. Confidence: Medium

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Monday): Mostly cloudy skies linger, but a few peeks of sun are possible later in the day. Afternoon highs in the upper 60s to low 70s remain a bit cooler than average. Winds from the northwest around 10 mph, with some gusts near 20 mph. Confidence: Medium-High

Tomorrow night: Partly cloudy with lows in the upper 50s to near 60 and light winds from the northwest. Confidence: Medium-High

A look ahead

Partly sunny and pleasantly warmer Tuesday with highs in the more seasonable mid-70s. Partly cloudy Tuesday night with lows in the upper 50s to low 60s. Confidence: Medium

Hopefully your shorts aren’t too far out of reach. High pressure positioned off the coast delivers a warming breeze from the south Wednesday and Thursday. Highs head for the upper 70s to low 80s Wednesday, and low to mid-80s Thursday, under partly to mostly sunny skies. Confidence: Medium

DC weather history for September 27

Heavy rain from Hurricane Gloria in 1985 set a daily record, though the storm ultimately dealt the region a lighter blow than initially feared.
